faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Medical Officer position is 02 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Medical Officer post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 72,000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Medical Officer post is 65 years. There are no specific age relaxations mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a valid registration from the respective State Medical Council or the National Medical Commission (NMC) to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Medical Officer post in the Dr. Shankarrao Chavan Government Medical College Nanded recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Medical Officer position is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Medical Officer recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer post will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. When is the interview date for the Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview for the Medical Officer post is scheduled to be held on 16 September 2026. Candidates are advised to be prepared for the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q10. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Dr. Shankarrao Chavan Government Medical College Nanded (Dr.S.C.G.M.C. Nanded).
